reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: getAllMembers is imported and registered as a live route handler in src/index.ts:77 — not dead code. Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json contains no trust_assumptions block; entry point is the authenticated REST API. Gate 3: src/api/ is explicitly in-scope and 'Bulk member enumeration via /api/members endpoint' is listed as a key_security_concerns item. Code confirms the Supabase query at L15-20 has no .limit()/.range(), and Promise.all at L52 has no concurrency cap. An attacker can trigger this via GET /api/members (after obtaining API_AUTH_TOKEN via env leak, Docker config, or git history), causing exfiltration of all member PII (discord_uid, student_number, generation) in a single unbounded response and exhaustion of Discord API rate limits. Severity MEDIUM maintained — requires pre-existing token compromise but the shared single credential model and explicit scope concern support this rating.
